design.concept: A two-step phone flow for a manager: first a compact queue of the team's pending expenses (who, how much, when), then one expense read like a memo (who, decisive facts, description, trail) with the decision at the very end. Approving takes one plain confirmation dialog; rejecting expands an inline reason field that must be filled before its button enables.

views.purpose: Queue of pending team expenses. Tapping a row selects it and opens the analysis.
One expense under review, read top to bottom and decided at the end. It has a back control to the queue. It is the first view when an expense arrives already selected.

design.decisions: The views are the queue and the analysis, switched only by the scene host in scenary mode. The host starts on the analysis when an expense is already selected, so the record carried in is not asked for again. The analysis follows the template's reading order: a card with the collaborator's name, amount, date, category and status, then the description, then the trail (resubmission and rejection reason). The decision block comes last and is never sticky. Approve opens a native dialog restating the name and amount. Rejecting uses a native disclosure whose textarea is required before 'Confirmar rejeição' enables. Both need no page state. The page-level draft and command states from the shared drive loading, error with retry, and the final statement. While a command runs the controls are inert. Success replaces the controls with a calm statement and there is no auto-advance. The queue uses the responsive data table with three always-visible columns, with the category under the name. Left out: the search bar, because the shared has no search source and the page may not filter; the proof viewer, because no row field holds a proof; the toast, because the template wants local success and no page banner. Danger styling is not used on reject.
